title: RESONANCE: A PLAGUE TALE LEGACY
summary: Refuses to start: "Shader Model 6.7 is not supported by this device". It also turns HDR10 on by itself on a display it reads as HDR and starts to a black screen, so HDR10 0 goes into its ENGINESETTINGS file.

excerpts.note: Finds the one `cmp eax, 67h` that compares the shader model with 6.7 and makes it 6.6, in memory only; with any other number of matches it touches nothing.

cause: D3DMetal reports Shader Model 6.6, because that is what it has, and the game refuses to start below 6.7.
